messages:
Aisha Rahman: Quick check-in 999need to finalize the partner quickstart package for the cloud marketplaces. Core deliverables: reference-arch, Terraform modules, CI that publishes artifacts, and a minimal smoke test harness.

Tom Becker: Agreed. We should keep the module API tiny. Suggest vars: cloud, env (dev|prod), enable_gpu (bool), gpu_profile (string). Defaults should avoid GPUs so partners can deploy cheaply.

Lena Ortiz: On the README side I'll add per-cloud SKU recommendations and a short 'matrix.md' mapping SKU -> tested image + notes. Also include a minimal docker image that users can run post-deploy to validate connectivity.

Aisha Rahman: For packaging: tarball with sha256 + semver tag. CI should have a dry-run publish and a gated publish once partner signs the CLA. Any objections to hosting artifacts in partner-artifacts.s3?

Tom Becker: s3 is fine. We'll add optional az artifacts mirror. CI (GitHub Actions) steps: lint, terraform fmt + validate, terraform plan (sandbox), build tar, compute sha256, upload to s3 (dry-run), run smoke tests. Keep plan short to avoid costs.

Matt Chen: Smoke tests should be lightweight: deploy a small replica set, hit /health, then run a single inference call (20 tokens) to verify model loads. We'll run in eu-west-1 and us-east-1.

DevOps-bot: Reminder: partner-enablement-review meeting scheduled Friday 10:00 PT.

Lena Ortiz: Example snippet for opting into GPU (for docs):

```hcl
module "refarch" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/partner-refarch//modules/root?ref=v0.1.0"
  cloud      = "azure"
  env        = "dev"
  enable_gpu = true
  gpu_profile = "A100-40GB"
}
```

Tom Becker: We'll add a compatibility list in the repo and a small script to map gpu_profile -> cloud SKU.

Aisha Rahman: Action items: Lena (docs + examples + matrix) // Tom (GH Actions pipeline + sandbox plan) // Matt (smoke harness + test runner) // Aisha (partner coordination & publishing policy). I'll post the draft to github and schedule the review. :thumbsup:

Matt Chen: I'll open PRs for the smoke runner and a tiny example app that calls the hosted endpoint and demonstrates retry/backoff.

Tom Becker: I'll prototype the pipeline this week and share links.

Lena Ortiz: Thanks, team. Posting initial README PR by Tuesday.
